proposals.before: In the first month of spring (which was the sixth month), His Majesty performed the plowing ceremony at Shanglin Park.
proposals.after: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, His Majesty performed the plowing ceremony at Shanglin Park.
proposals.reason: Chinese 六月春正月 is a corruption of 六年春正月 (sixth year); the idiomatic rendering wrongly treats it as the sixth month.

proposals.before: Sixth month spring first month: His Majesty plowed at Shanglin.
proposals.after: Sixth year spring first month: His Majesty plowed at Shanglin.
proposals.reason: Literal mirrors the corrupted 六月; context of the Shiyuan sequence requires 六年.

proposals.before: Twelfth month Gengxu: Chancellor Yin died.
proposals.after: Twelfth month Gengxu: Chancellor Xin died.
proposals.reason: Chinese 訢 is Xin; literal wrongly reads Yin.

decisions.reason: Chapter s0061’s 六月春正月 is impossible (sixth month cannot be spring’s first month) and follows year-five autumn events before 二月; CText’s Han Shu witness restores 六年春正月, so the idiomatic must read sixth year, not sixth month.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 六年春正月，上耕于上林。

decisions.reason: The same corrupt 六月 must be read as 六年; CText’s edition has 六年春正月，上耕于上林, so the literal correctly replaces “Sixth month” with “Sixth year.”

sourceWitness.excerpt: 六年春正月，上耕于上林。

decisions.reason: Focus unit 丞相訢 gives the personal name 訢 (Xin); the idiomatic already has Xin, and literal “Yin” is a misreading with no support in the Chinese.
